proposal.title: Content contract for one topic (example: 07 Ylioppilastutkinto ja alustava yo-suunnitelma)
proposal.detail:
File: content/topics/07-ylioppilastutkinto.md, Markdown with YAML front matter.

FRONT MATTER (all required unless marked optional)
- id: op1-07-ylioppilastutkinto (stable slug)
- module: OP1 (enum OP1|OP2)
- order: 7 (unique within the site, 1-18)
- title: "Ylioppilastutkinto ja alustava yo-suunnitelma"
- summary: one sentence in plain Finnish
- curriculum: list of {code, kind: tavoite|sisalto|yleinen_tavoite, eperusteet_id} — here [{code: OP1.t6, kind: tavoite, eperusteet_id: 6835293}, {code: OP1.t7, ...}, {code: OP1.s1, kind: sisalto}, {code: OP1.s8, kind: sisalto}]. The build resolves code to exact wording from data/curriculum.yaml and fails on unknown codes. Text is never typed here.
- curriculum_source: {peruste: 6828810, diaarinumero: OPH-2263-2019, checked: 2026-11-21}
- law (optional): list, e.g. ["Lukiolaki 714/2018 §26"]
- suggested_timing: {year: 1, term: kevät, note: "esimerkki, koulu päättää"}
- role: core | extension
- duration_options: [45, 60, 75] (minutes; 75 is the master plan; 90 optional)
- self_study_minutes: 15-25
- prerequisites: [op1-06-hops] (topic ids; may be empty)
- hops_part (optional): opiskelusuunnitelma | ylioppilastutkintosuunnitelma | jatko-opinto- ja urasuunnitelma
- official_links: list of {title, url, publisher, read: YYYY-MM-DD, changes_yearly: bool} — here the YTL tutkinnon rakenne, ilmoittautuminen and koepäivät pages, read 2026-11-21. The build fails if 'read' is missing or older than a set age (e.g. 12 months).
- yearly_facts: list of fact keys from data/yearly-facts.yaml that the topic mentions only by link (e.g. ytl_enrolment_deadline, ytl_exam_dates)
- school_adapts: list of things marked 'esimerkki' (e.g. the school's own earlier enrolment date, Wilma practice)
- materials: list (paper, device, printout)
- accessibility: notes (e.g. 'tasks work without a device')
- last_reviewed: date

BODY SECTIONS (fixed H2 headings, checked by the build in this order)
1. ## Opiskelijalle — student text, 300-600 words, selkeä yleiskieli, with 'Osaan…' outcomes at the top that mirror the cited tavoitteet. Facts only in rule form (e.g. 'vähintään viisi koetta, äidinkieli pakollinen'); every changing figure is a link.
2. ## Tehtävät — 1-3 tasks. Each has a title, time, what you need, max 5 numbered steps, and an offline alternative. At least one task uses a real official tool via a stable link (here: the YTL combination check). No model answers to grade against (OP is S/H, based on self-assessment).
3. ## Pohdinta — 2-3 open prompts, never asking for personal data to be shared with the site, plus a 4-step self-assessment against the 'Osaan' outcomes (not graded).
4. ## Itseopiskelun askel — goal; time estimate; read → do one task → reflect → 'next step'; what to write into which HOPS part; a tick 'Merkitse tehdyksi' that writes localStorage only on click.
5. ## Tuntisuunnitelma (75 min) — table of phases with minutes, activity, teacher's role, swap option, cut-if-short. Master: Virittäytyminen 5 / Aiemman tiedon aktivointi 10 / Lyhyt alustus 10 max / Työskentely todellisella työkalulla 25 / Pari- tai pienryhmäpohdinta 10 / HOPS-askel ja exit 10 / Puskuri 5.
   ### 60 min — cut the buffer, trim the task to 20 and the activation to 5.
   ### 45 min — hook 3, input 7, task 20, HOPS and exit 10, reflection as homework; no group phase.
   ### 90 min (optional) — add a peer-feedback round or a second task.
   Plus: teacher prep (max 5 lines), open-question bank, a leading-question warning, an 'assumption check' (OPH diversity principles), ground rules, and no forced disclosure.
6. ## Eriyttäminen — easier path; deeper path; S2 and plain-language support (glossary); reading, attention and anxiety adjustments; no-device version; link to the learning-support page (rules changed 1.8.2025) instead of restating it.
7. ## Milloin opinto-ohjaajalle — concrete triggers (e.g. unsure whether the combination qualifies, needs special arrangements, a deadline is near, stress) and wellbeing and help links (Opintopolku guidance, Ohjaamo, student healthcare), each with a read date.
8. ## Lähteet — generated from front matter: curriculum codes with exact wording, law, and official links with read dates.

Checks: unknown curriculum codes, a missing section, a link without a read date, a hard-coded yearly figure (matched against a pattern list such as dates and € amounts in yearly-fact topics), or an external non-link resource all fail the build.

proposal.title: Site structure (static, Python-built, no JavaScript needed to read)
proposal.detail:
/ Etusivu — what the site is (an open backbone for lukion opinto-ohjaus following LOPS 2019), two entry buttons: 'Opettajalle / opinto-ohjaajalle' and 'Opiskelijalle: itseopiskelupolku', module cards for OP1 and OP2, 'opetussuunnitelma tarkistettu 2026-11-21', and the licence (CC BY 4.0 proposed; operator decision).
/op1/ and /op2/ Module pages — the official module name, 2 op, pakollinen, S/H assessment, the module's tavoitteet and sisällöt in exact wording (generated from data/curriculum.yaml, linked to ePerusteet), a coverage matrix (topic x code), and the ordered topic list with timing labelled 'esimerkki'.
/op1/07-ylioppilastutkinto/ Topic page — two views of the same Markdown: the default student view (Opiskelijalle, Tehtävät, Pohdinta, Itseopiskelun askel, Milloin opinto-ohjaajalle, Lähteet) and /op1/07-ylioppilastutkinto/tunti/ as the lesson view (curriculum box, Tuntisuunnitelma 75/60/45, Eriyttäminen, Lähteet). Both are plain HTML links, so they work without JavaScript.
/polku/ Self-study path — all 18 steps in suggested order (Y1 → Y3), with a 'free order' note. Progress ticks and optional notes are stored under one namespaced localStorage key (e.g. 'loo:v1'), written only on the student's click, never on page load. A visible 'Tyhjennä tietoni' button, export or print of one's own notes, and a note that data stays on this device (warning about shared school computers). Without JavaScript the page is a plain ordered list.
/tulosta/ Print views — one print stylesheet; per-topic lesson plan print (tunti view prints cleanly on A4), plus 'all OP1 lesson plans' and 'all OP2 lesson plans' combined pages.
/opetussuunnitelma/ Curriculum page — the yleiset tavoitteet, OP1 and OP2 objectives and contents with codes, which topics serve each, ch. 4.1 summary (rights, HOPS three parts, roles), law references (§25, §26, §27, §28), and an explicit 'koulu päättää' list.
/lahteet/ Sources and current facts — all official links grouped by topic with publisher and read date, plus the yearly-facts table (task d) with a 'tarkista ajantasainen tieto' link per row.
/tietosuoja/ Tietosuojaseloste — no personal data collected, no accounts, analytics, forms, embeds or third-party fonts; what localStorage holds and how to clear it; GitHub Pages as host logs IP addresses (verify wording against GitHub docs); contact via repository issues or a role address; right to complain to the Tietosuojavaltuutettu; version and date.
/saavutettavuus/ Saavutettavuusseloste — voluntary, WCAG 2.1 AA target, known gaps, feedback route.
Build guarantees: zero external requests (self-hosted fonts, a grep test for external hosts in the output), reflow at 320 px, contrast tokens, heading order, link text and alt text checks, and every page reachable without JavaScript.

proposal.title: Facts that change yearly: link, never copy
proposal.detail:
Store these in data/yearly-facts.yaml as key, plain-language rule, official URL, publisher, read date. Topics may state the stable rule but must link for the value.
- ytl_exam_dates: yo-koepäivät per session. YTL /fi/tutkinnon-suorittaminen/koepaivat (path named on the YTL index, not opened).
- ytl_enrolment_deadline: YTL last dates 1.12 (spring) and 5.6 (autumn) are stable (verified) but must be linked. The school's own earlier date is marked as a school example.
- ytl_fees: exam and retake fees (YTL).
- ytl_rules_changes: English-language exam (2028 per Yliopistovalinnat, as read by the researcher), new subjects or test changes (YTL).
- joint_application_windows: spring first and second higher-education joint applications, autumn joint application, and the joint application for toinen aste (Opintopolku and OPH news). Values for 2026 were verified but are not to be copied.
- admission_results_dates: certificate-selection and final results dates (Opintopolku).
- places_and_quota: number of places and the ensikertalaiskiintiö share (about 70% in spring 2026, about 74% in autumn 2026, so it changes per round; OPH news).
- todistusvalinta_tables: university scoring tables (11 tables from 2026; Yliopistovalinnat) and AMK criteria (per programme on Opintopolku).
- cut_off_points: past pisterajat (Vipunen report linked from Yliopistovalinnat; Vipunen unread).
- entrance_exam_dates: AMK valintakoe and university valintakokeet dates (Opintopolku, Yliopistovalinnat).
- study_right_rule: the one-study-right rule from autumn 2026 is stable as a rule but recent, so link to OPH or Opintopolku.
- kela_student_aid: opintoraha, asumislisä, opintolaina, income limits, koulumatkatuki, YTHS fee and due date (kela.fi/opintotuki).
- intti_callups: kutsunnat dates and age cohort, women's voluntary service application window (intti.fi).
- civil_service: length and application (siviilipalvelus.fi, URL to verify).
- employment_services: TE-services moved to municipal työllisyysalueet on 1.1.2025 (likely). Työmarkkinatori services, and Ammattinetti's current home (to verify).
- learning_support_rules: learning support and special education, changed 1.8.2025 (OPH).
- guidance_services: Opintopolku neuvonta (chat availability varies), Ohjaamo locations, wellbeing helplines (verify at build).
- curriculum_version: ePerusteet publication date (last 2026-05-22) plus the amendment status; the site shows 'tarkistettu' with a date.
- international: Euroguidance and Studyinfo addresses and exchange deadlines (unverified, find current URLs).
Rule for the checker: any number, date or euro amount that sits next to one of these keys in topic text fails the build unless it is inside a link label to the official page.
